newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Shabby bullion thumps S.African gold shares to end.
newsitem.headline: Shabby bullion thumps S.African gold shares to end.

text.p: The bullion price fell through $377 an ounce and took with it support for gold shares, forcing them weaker all day and knocking more than 2.5 percent off the index at the close.
As bullion stuck its nose above $377 briefly in afternoon trade, shares hopped cautiously up before collapsing again.

The index lost 2.56 percent or 43.7 points to 1,660.9. Vaal Reefs shed 900 cents to 352 rand, Kloof lost 100 cents to 42 rand, Freegold was down 80 cents at 39 rand and Amgold cut its value by 800 cents to 405 rand.

Shadowed by the one point Bank and prime lending rate hike, industrial shares struggled to escape the gloom of Thursday's panic selling. Bravely clinging to levels, they failed to recover sufficient losses and ended down.
But dealers said their fall had been limited by the firmer rand and bond markets
The industrial index fell 28.1 points to 7,952 and the all-share index fell 47.7 points to 6,726.7.
Overall, trade was dull and while volumes were moderate, dealers said interest was stifled by Thursday's alarmed trade.
Rate hike gloom was expected to overhang the market next week with consumer-related stocks coming under pressure.
